result.reason: The Licensor indemnity substantially reaches the preferred position: it covers third-party IP claims, breach of law, Licensor-caused data breaches, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, includes affiliates and standard procedures, and is carved out of the liability cap. However, Licensee's indemnity is not limited to Licensee-provided content and breach of law; it also covers use of the Licensed Technology in material breach of license restrictions. Its opening language may also extend beyond third-party claims to general commercial or legal liability. The edits are otherwise targeted and preserve unrelated commercial terms, but the operative language does not fully satisfy the playbook despite the margin comment.
